## library
```{r}
library(conflicted)
library(tidyverse)
library(lubridate)
library(ggpubr)
library(nlme)
library(emmeans)

source('utils.R')
conflicts_prefer(dplyr::filter)
```

## data
```{r}
BW = read.delim("../Data/all_clean_bodyweights.txt")
dat <- BW |> 
  mutate(Facility = factor(Facility, levels = c("Vivarium", "Farm")),
         Treatment = factor(Treatment, levels = c("Diwater", "Chlorinated")),
         Sex = factor(Sex, levels = c("F", "M")),
         SubjectID = factor(SubjectID), FamilyID = factor(FamilyID),
         AgeWeeks = Day / 7) |>
  arrange(Sex, SubjectID, Day)

out <- '../Result/Bodyweight/'
if (!dir.exists(out)) {
  dir.create(out, recursive = TRUE)
}
```

## growth curve by day
### function
```{r}
fit_bw <- function(data, fixed, method = "ML") {
  lme(fixed, data = data,
      random = ~ 1 | SubjectID,
      correlation = corCAR1(value = 0.5, form = ~ AgeWeeks | SubjectID),
      weights = varPower(form = ~ Day), method = method,
      control = lmeControl(opt = "optim", maxIter = 200, msMaxIter = 1000))
}

simple_effects <- function(emm, by_day = FALSE) {
  fac_by <- if (by_day) c("Treatment", "Day") else "Treatment"
  trt_by <- if (by_day) c("Facility", "Day") else "Facility"
  a <- contrast(emm, "revpairwise", by = fac_by, adjust = "none") |>
    summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) |> as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(effect = "Farm - Vivarium", stratum = as.character(Treatment))
  b <- contrast(emm, "revpairwise", by = trt_by, adjust = "none") |>
    summary(infer = c(TRUE, TRUE)) |> as.data.frame() |>
    mutate(effect = "Chlorinated - Diwater", stratum = as.character(Facility))
  bind_rows(a, b)
}
```

### Longitudinal mixed models
```{r}
form <- BW ~ splines::ns(Day, knots = c(35, 49, 70), Boundary.knots = c(22, 86)) * Facility * Treatment

models <- list()
dat_anova <- list()
dat_fitted <- list()

for(sex in levels(dat$Sex)){
  dat_s <- dat |> filter(Sex == sex)
  full_fit <- fit_bw(dat_s, form)
  reduced <- list(
    Facility = BW ~ splines::ns(Day, knots = c(35, 49, 70), Boundary.knots = c(22, 86)) * Treatment,
    Treatment = BW ~ splines::ns(Day, knots = c(35, 49, 70), Boundary.knots = c(22, 86)) * Facility,
    Facility_Treatment_interaction = BW ~ splines::ns(Day, knots = c(35, 49, 70), Boundary.knots = c(22, 86)) * (Facility + Treatment))
  for (term in names(reduced)) {
    reduced_fit <- fit_bw(dat_s, reduced[[term]])
    a <- anova(reduced_fit, full_fit)
    dat_anova[[paste(sex, term)]] <- tibble(Sex = sex, test = term,
                                          df = a$df[2] - a$df[1], LR = a$L.Ratio[2], p = a$`p-value`[2])
  }
  dat_fitted[[sex]] <- dat_s |> mutate(fitted = as.numeric(fitted(full_fit)), 
                                    residual = as.numeric(resid(full_fit, type = "normalized")))
  models[[sex]] <- full_fit
}

dat_anova <- bind_rows(dat_anova) |> mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p, "BH"))
```

### Common-age marginal means and contrasts
```{r}
common_low = 24
common_high = 85
average <- list()
pointwise <- list()
curves <- list()

for (sex in names(models)){
    f <- models[[sex]]
    rg <- ref_grid(f, data = f$data, at = list(Day = seq(common_low, common_high)), cov.keep = "Day", mode = "containment")
    em <- emmeans(rg, ~ Facility * Treatment, weights = "equal")
    average[[paste(sex)]] <- simple_effects(em) |> mutate(Sex = sex)
    em_day <- emmeans(f, ~ Facility * Treatment | Day, data = f$data,
                      at = list(Day = c(28, 35, 42, 49, 56, 63, 70, 77, 84)), mode = "containment")
    pointwise[[paste(sex)]] <- simple_effects(em_day, TRUE) |> mutate(Sex = sex)
      em_curve <- emmeans(f, ~ Facility * Treatment | Day, data = f$data,
                          at = list(Day = seq(common_low, common_high)), mode = "containment")
      curves[[sex]] <- as.data.frame(confint(em_curve)) |> mutate(Sex = sex)
}
average <- bind_rows(average) |> group_by(Sex) |> mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p.value, "BH")) |> ungroup()
pointwise <- bind_rows(pointwise) |> group_by(Sex) |> mutate(q_BH = p.adjust(p.value, "BH")) |> ungroup()
curves <- bind_rows(curves)

write.csv(pointwise |> select(Sex, contrast, effect, Treatment, Facility, stratum, everything()) |> 
            arrange(Sex, contrast, Day),
          file = paste0(out,"Compare_BW_by_day.csv"), row.names = FALSE)
```

### Figures
```{r}
g <- ggplot(dat, aes(Day, BW, group = SubjectID, color = Facility)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.35) + geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(data = curves, aes(y = NULL, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = Facility,
                               group = Facility), inherit.aes = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(data = curves, aes(y = emmean, group = Facility), linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(Sex ~ Treatment, labeller = labeller(Sex = c(`F` = "Female", M = "Male"))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_facility, aesthetics = c("color","fill")) + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Age (days)", y = "Body weight (g)")

ggsave(filename = paste0(out, "BW_compare_facility.pdf"),
       width = 7, height = 5, plot = g)

g <- ggplot(dat, aes(Day, BW, group = SubjectID, color = Treatment)) +
  geom_line(alpha = 0.18, linewidth = 0.35) + geom_point(alpha = 0.25, size = 0.7) +
  geom_ribbon(data = curves, aes(y = NULL, ymin = lower.CL, ymax = upper.CL, fill = Treatment,
                               group = Treatment), inherit.aes = TRUE, alpha = 0.15, color = NA) +
  geom_line(data = curves, aes(y = emmean, group = Treatment), linewidth = 1) +
  facet_grid(Sex ~ Facility, labeller = labeller(Sex = c(`F` = "Female", M = "Male"))) +
  scale_color_manual(values = col_treatment, aesthetics = c("color","fill")) + theme_bw() +
  labs(x = "Age (days)", y = "Body weight (g)")

ggsave(filename = paste0(out, "BW_compare_treatment.pdf"),
       width = 7, height = 5, plot = g)

```
